workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-pxh4-856f-4h89] PyJWT: HS256/384/512 verify accepts empty HMAC key via oct JWK (PyJWK/PyJWKClient) enabling token forgery (Affects pyjwt < 2.14.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade pyjwt to patched release >= 2.14.0: pip install --upgrade 'pyjwt>=2.14.0' (Advisory: GHSA-pxh4-856f-4h89)

workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-x33g-cr3x-6449] PyJWT accepts inconsistent OKP x/d JWKs, causing public/private key identity confusion (Affects pyjwt < 2.15.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade pyjwt to patched release >= 2.15.0: pip install --upgrade 'pyjwt>=2.15.0' (Advisory: GHSA-x33g-cr3x-6449)
